_comment: This file shows two example configurations for openclaw-warden.
_comment2: Copy the 'minimal' or 'full' plugins section into your openclaw.json.
_comment3: JSON does not support comments — these underscore keys are just documentation.

minimal_example._description: Zero config — just enable the plugin. All rules use sensible defaults.

full_example._description: All options shown with non-default values for demonstration.

parallelFirst.message: Before dispatching subagents, decompose the task into independent parallel workstreams. Spawn all independent agents simultaneously rather than sequentially. Identify dependencies and only sequence what truly depends on prior results.
